subject: Culture
title: Hindu Temple Cosmology
description: A quick, practical guide to Hindu Temple Cosmology.

hook.text: Angkor Wat encodes the Hindu creation myth in stone. Its towers map Mount Meru, home of the gods.

buildup.text: Every Hindu temple is a microcosm. The sanctum represents the cave of the heart; the tower reaches heaven.

discovery.text: The 'garbhagriha'—womb chamber—is dark and small, forcing worshippers into intimate contact with the divine.

twist.text: Temple placement follows astronomical alignments. Konark's Sun Temple is oriented so sunrise hits the entrance.

climax.text: The temple doesn't represent the cosmos. In Hindu thought, it IS the cosmos made walkable.

punchline.text: Enter a temple and you walk through the universe.

quiz.question: What is the 'garbhagriha' in a Hindu temple?
